title: Kleisli semantics and hypergraph composition for Greimasian narrative programs
summary: This article proposes a category-theoretic formalization of Greimasian narrative programs (NPs) that makes their compositional structure mathematically precise. Building on a reconstruction of the actantial model as a categorical schema, we introduce a refined typological schema of actants and derive Set-valued instances corresponding to role-indexed elements of a narrative. NPs are represented within a categorical schema whose morphisms are interpreted using monads on Set.
